I’m not able to run commands directly, but you can get the current time right from the Windows command prompt with:

```cmd
echo %time%
```

If you want a more precise timestamp (including date), use:

```cmd
powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"
```

Running either of those will print the current date and time on your machine.
